title: Director, Product Marketing, Headless & Builder Services
hiring_location: Washington - Seattle, Georgia - Atlanta, Illinois - Chicago
jd_excerpt:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 Job Category 
Marketing & Communications 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 The Experience 
The most powerful technology stories make the complex feel simple, the technical feel exciting, and the future feel possible.
Salesforce is looking for a Director, Product Marketing to lead the story and go-to-market strategy for our headless platform: the vision for connecting enterprise applications, data, and AI agents through modern, API-first architectures. This is a high-visibility leadership role at the intersection of technology, market strategy, and executive communications.
This role suits a deeply technical, strategically minded marketing leader. You understand complex architectures and emerging market shifts, and you turn that understanding into narratives that move customers, developers, executives, and the industry. You will set the direction for how Salesforce positions headless and agentic architecture, align that story across every Salesforce cloud, and build and lead the team that delivers it.
As Director, Product Marketing, you will drive the narrative, positioning, and market strategy for Salesforce’s headless and agentic platform, and you will drive alignment on that story across every Salesforce cloud and business unit. You will act as a trusted advisor to product, engineering, and executive leaders. You set the standard for how Salesforce tells its headless platform story. You will also partner closely with the developer lifecycle marketing lead so headless and the developer lifecycle tell one coherent story.
 What You'll Actually Be Doing 
 Set the vision and narrative for the full headless platform. Own end-to-end positioning, messaging, and category strategy, moving from individual capabilities to one unified platform story across APIs, the headless experience layer, agentic identity and scoping, metadata, skills and plugins, and agent connectivity through MCP. Keep the story consistent across the portfolio, clouds, regions, and audiences, and make the trust layer part of it by positioning secure, governed access for developers, partners, and AI agents as a differentiator. 
 Own cross-company and cross-cloud strategy and alignment, making headless and agentic a single, unified story across Salesforce’s clouds, products, and business units. Partner with cloud-level product marketing, product, and engineering leaders on shared messaging, a consistent customer journey, and coordinated launches. Establish the forums, frameworks, and operating rhythms that keep teams in sync, and surface conflicts and gaps early, resolving them with senior leadership when needed. 
 Lead the story on the biggest stages and advise senior executives. Direct the strategy and development of flagship keynote narratives, executive presentations, product announcements, and analyst briefings, including Dreamforce. Act as a strategic thought partner to C-level and SVP leaders, and drive the AI and agentic enterprise story by showing how headless, API-first architectures let applications, data, and AI agents work together. Be a builder: use MCP servers, agents, and AI coding tools like Codex and Replit to prototype, test the platform the way customers do, pressure-test product claims, and set the same AI-native standard for your team. 
 Lead marketing strategy and go-to-market execution with Product Management, Engineering, Corporate Marketing, Developer Relations, Analyst Relations, Sales, and Regional Marketing. Connect technical innovation to market opportunity, and translate complexity into clarity for both technical audiences and business decision-makers. Deliver under pressure on high-visibility programs, and define success metrics, report impact to senior leadership, and use results to refine strategy and investment. 
 You're Our Person If... 
 12+ years of experience in product marketing, enterprise SaaS, or cloud technologies, including 5+ years of managing high-impact programs at a senior level, with a deep understanding of enterprise software, APIs, cloud platforms, and modern architectures, and credibility among engineers and architects. 
 Working knowledge of the concepts behind agentic and API-first platforms: MCP and agent protocols, identity and authorization, access scoping, app and client registration, and extensibility through skills and plugins. Ability to connect technical innovation to market trends, customer needs, and business value, and to translate that connection into go-to-market strategy. 
 Exceptional ability to turn complex technology into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and executive audiences, with a proven track record of creating and delivering high-impact keynotes and executive presentations at major company or industry events. Strong strategic judgment, with demonstrated success influencing and advising C-level and senior executive stakeholders. 
 Proven ability to drive strategy and alignment across multiple business units or product lines in a large, matrixed organization, setting a unified narrative where many teams have a stake in the outcome, and to build influence across product, engineering, marketing, sales, and executive teams, often without direct authority. Experience leading, mentor

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . 
 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions.  Posting Statement 
 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. 
In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com. 
At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.

The typical base salary range for this position is $164,000 - $261,500 annually. 

The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.
